svg.aria-label: Sri Kalyan Ippili: systems, backend and ML. Twelve projects in two sides, then experience and contact.

svg.text: Final-year CS at PES University. I
build products that are hard to build,
the layer underneath than wrap it.
GO · RUST · PYTHON · C · TS · SWIFT
GitOps, self-healing and chaos from one file
A container runtime, built from namespaces up
Converts anything to anything, and says how
Finds internships and new-grad roles before you look
Raft from the paper, inside a deterministic simulator
An LLM inference engine with grammar-constrained decoding
Evolution that is blind to what it evolves
Whatever is playing on your Mac, painted live
A 2003 digicam, harsh flash and all, in your phone
The whole city of Bengaluru, simulated for a day
Nine albums as one cloud of light
Ran marketing, operations and go-to-market for an AI workflow-automation startup.
Shaped the core product: client-scoped context packs with human approval gates.
Mapped 13 competitors to define the category and ideal customer, and built the
Co-built SentinelEdge, a zero-trust edge-AI traffic platform where every camera
reading is signed and anchored on a private blockchain. Built its Merkle
tamper-evidence auditor, provenance receipts that can be verified offline, and a
Bengaluru digital twin with 1,377 real signals.
Led the university's tech club and directed Horcrux 2.0, a 24-hour state-level
hackathon, with a 120+ member team across seven functions. Also ran Survivor
Island, a DSA challenge built to mirror real interviews.
Led a 40-member team for a student initiative supporting families of Indian
martyrs, across events drawing 8,000–10,000 people. Grew the handle by 1,200+
followers and sold out Raas-Leher, the flagship Garba night, at about 3,000 people
3rd place, Epoch 2.0 datathon · Nominated team, Smart India Hackathon 2024
I'm looking for software engineering roles in backend, systems and ML infrastructure, from 2027.
Whatever you're working on, I'm always up for a conversation.
